steps.title: One query, two views
steps.body: Pick Alice, then Bob. Same query, same client, one token — acting_as per request decides which rooms exist for you.

steps.title: Send as Alice
steps.body: Send a message as Alice. Open a tab as Bob and one as Carol: only the room members see it.

steps.title: Filtered history, not app code
steps.body: Click the clock on any message: its edit timeline is a filter on one attribute, served by the audit provider — nothing here is application code.

steps.title: The guard, in the model
steps.body: The Message entity carries the RLS guard that just did all of this: only an author may edit, only members may read. It ships with the model, not with this app.
